name: ESO 349-031 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 349-031, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: e349031-hubble
story: This dwarf irregular galaxy belongs to a group of galaxies in Sculptor and is a companion to the bright spiral NGC 7793. Hubble resolved its individual stars to measure its distance.

claims.text: ESO 349-031 (SDIG) is a dwarf irregular galaxy in a group (filament) in Sculptor
SDIG is a companion to the bright spiral galaxy NGC 7793
Its distance was measured from Hubble ACS images of its stars (tip of the red giant branch, program 9771)
